caption: The drawing features two knitted garments in muted brown and beige colors, laid on a neutral, light beige background. The main object is a full-length, knee-high sock with a rounded foot and a ribbed cuff at the top edge. The sock is rendered with visible knitted texture, appearing soft and slightly worn, with subtle shading indicating folds and contours. Overlapping the top portion of the sock is another similarly textured section of knitted fabric, likely a second sock, folded neatly but extending horizontally across the vertical sock. Both pieces have ribbed cuffs with a lighter beige tone compared to the main body of the fabric. The drawing is signed "H. Landon Brown" in the bottom left corner.
title: Stockings
